title: Nirdosha Domain Service Catalog v1
description: RFC 0029 §7.1 translation boundary: a versioned, domain-authority-approved catalog of services a screen.service reference may select. The catalog, not the screen and not an LLM, is the source of the security-critical meaning -- a screen may only select an entry and supply its allowed_parameters; it cannot invent an effect, broaden an authority, or select a gateway. Loaded by crates/cargo-nirdosha/src/service_catalog.rs.

service.description: One entry per service name. The TOML table key ([service.<name>]) is the service name a screen.service.name references; it must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ and is unique by construction (a duplicate TOML key is a parse error, not a silently-merged entry).

resource.description: The already-admitted canonical resource identity this service acts on (e.g. TransferRequest, Account). Never inferred from screen data_binding.entities -- the two are cross-checked, not derived from one another.

effect.description: The typed effect this service authorizes, dotted domain.action form (e.g. transfer.request, funds.reserve). This is the RFC 0029 effect_closure entry the compiled AdmissionReportV1 carries; a screen may never name an effect the catalog entry doesn't declare here.

policy_kind.description: RFC 0029 §8 policy kind. Restricted to the four kinds with published formal operational semantics/proof obligations/evidence schema (§8.1-§8.4) as of the Phase 0 exit gate; the remaining ten kinds are formal-artifact backlog and are rejected here, not silently downgraded.

gateway.description: Name of the enforcement gateway that executes this effect once admitted. Must be a member of crates/cargo-nirdosha/src/service_catalog.rs's KNOWN_GATEWAYS allow-list; an unregistered gateway name is a catalog load error, not a deferred codegen failure.

required_facts.description: Fact identifiers (PIP-supplied, e.g. subject_identity, fresh_balance, daily_limit) the admission adapter must resolve into Fact nodes before the effect can be admitted. An unresolved required fact is an admission failure or Indeterminate, per failure_posture -- never a silently-skipped check.

allowed_parameters.description: The exhaustive set of parameter keys a screen.service.parameters table may set for this entry. A screen supplying any other key is rejected at generation time (undeclared parameter), not passed through.

failure_posture.description: v1 scope: only FailClosed is supported -- an Indeterminate or Unsupported admission result always blocks generation. A fail-open posture is not representable in this schema version.
